Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard (Reaffirmed 1998) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
NEEDLE HOLDER, EYE, KALTS PATTERN 



1- Scope — Covers dimensional and other requirements for Kalt's pattern needle holder used in 
eye surgery. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 

3. Material 

3.1 Needle holder shall be of stainless steel conforming to Designation 30Cr13 of 18:6603-1972 
1 Specification for stainless steel bars and flats \ 

3;2 Screws and pins shall be made of the same material as used for the needle holder. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The surface of the needle holder shall be free from seams, burrs, pits, flaws any other defects. 

4.2 The edges shall be even and rounded. 

4.3 The component halves shall open and close fully and freely without any undue side play at the joint. 

4.4 One jaw shall have straight knurling with a groove and the other shall have fine diamond pattern 
cross cuts. On closure, the jaws shall meet fully and accurately. 

4.5 The catch and latch arrangement shall work effectively. 

4.6 The needle holder shall be symmetrical and well-balanced. 

4.7 The needle holder shall be polished bright, passivated and demagnetized. 

5. Heat Treatment — The needle holder shall be hardened and tempered to give a hardness of 430 
to 490 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Performance — A suture needle of 5 mm length, half-circle type shall be gripped between the 
jaws of the needle holder and it shall be made to pierce a piece of soft leather 0*5 mm thick. The 
needle held by the paws shall not slip. The needle holder shall also be able to grip 8-0 thread 
without slippage. 

6.2 Flexibility 

6.2.1 A force of moderate degree shall be applied to each shank by the fingers, attempting to bend 
the shank on the width. This shall be repeated at several points along the shank. The test shall 
then be repeated in a plane at right angles to the first. On completion of the test, the shank shall 
not have acquired permanent set. 

6.2.2 The terminal 5 mm of the jaws shall be made to bite on a piece of firm rubber 2 mm thick 
and needle holder locked by manual compression force. This test shall be repeated six times. On 
completion of this test, the jaws shall continue to meet accurately. 

6.3 Corrosion Resistance — The instrument shall satisfy the boiling and autoclaving test as 
specified in IS: 7531-1975 'Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of 
stainless steel surgical instruments'. 

7. Marking — Each needle holder shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's 
name, initials or recognized trade-mark. 

7.1 ISI Certification Mar king — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Adopted 28 June 1976
